title: The System Design Interview
objectives: Explain The System Design Interview in interview terms
Apply The System Design Interview to an India-scale example

cards.title: Why this matters in interviews
cards.body: The System Design Interview shows up when you design systems like UPI payments at chai stalls. Interviewers want a crisp problem statement, not textbook recitation.

cards.title: Mental model
cards.body: Picture The System Design Interview as a control knob: you tune it when latency, consistency, or cost diverge. Name the user journey first, then attach components.

cards.title: Request flow sketch
cards.body: Walk through a read-heavy path for The System Design Interview: client → edge → service → data store → back. Say where you would measure p95.

cards.body: Over-indexing on The System Design Interview without measuring often creates hidden coupling. Call out what breaks first under 10× traffic in India peak hours.

cards.title: How to explain it aloud
cards.body: Use a 3-step script: (1) user goal, (2) where The System Design Interview sits in the diagram, (3) one metric + one failure you'd alert on.

questions.prompt: When discussing The System Design Interview, which opening line best frames functional scope?

choices.label: State primary user actions and success metrics

questions.explanation: Interviewers reward clarity on who does what before components.

questions.prompt: In a naive The System Design Interview design, click the first bottleneck under sudden traffic.
questions.explanation: Single-instance paths saturate before well-sharded edges.

questions.explanation: Horizontal scaling matches variable Indian peak patterns.

questions.explanation: Reliability properties dominate system design discussions.
